title: GamingLANDR.com
tagline: Cosmonaut-themed intelligence hub aggregating gaming leaks and rumors across Twitter, Bluesky, and Reddit.
overview: GamingLANDR.com is an upcoming space/cosmonaut-themed intelligence hub tracking and cross-verifying gaming industry leaks and rumors. It synthesizes real-time chatter and breaking reports from X (Twitter), the AT Protocol (Bluesky), and r/GamingLeaksAndRumours into a unified radar feed with credibility scoring and spoiler controls.
architectureOverview: Multi-stream event listeners poll and webhook-subscribe to Bluesky, Twitter/X firehoses, and Reddit feeds. Ingested claims are normalized, deduplicated via semantic vector similarity, and relayed to cosmonaut HUD clients over WebSockets.

takeaways.challenge: Aggregating unformatted rumor threads across multiple disparate social APIs with varying rate limits.
takeaways.solution: Architected an edge queue consumer with priority backoff and automatic cross-platform claim deduplication.

takeaways.challenge: Filtering signal from noise while preserving chronological breaking alerts.
takeaways.solution: Designed a community-weighted veracity rating system alongside spoiler tagging and provenance chain inspection.

title: The Key
tagline: Interactive court locator and real-time pickup matchmaking platform for streetballers.
overview: The Key is a basketball court discovery and pickup matchmaking platform designed for streetballers. Named after the painted area under the basket where games are won and lost, the platform maps nearby outdoor and indoor courts with crowd-verified conditions (rim height, surface grip, net quality, night lighting) and lets players organize quick 3v3 and 5v5 pickup runs with live headcount tracking.
architectureOverview: Geospatial radius queries and bounding-box indexing are powered by PostgreSQL with PostGIS. Real-time court presence and pickup queue state are managed via WebSockets with Redis pub/sub backplanes, ensuring instantaneous updates when players RSVP or check into a court.

takeaways.challenge: Preventing ghost check-ins and keeping live court occupancy counts accurate.
takeaways.solution: Engineered automated geofencing with time-decayed presence heartbeats so player statuses clear automatically when leaving the court perimeter.

takeaways.challenge: Coordinating spontaneous pickup games across fragmented group chats.
takeaways.solution: Designed dynamic court lobbies with RSVP thresholds that send push notifications once a court reaches the required quorum (e.g. 6 players for 3v3).
